How an Inquiry Moves

From drawings to installed element

A fabrication inquiry is only useful if it carries the right information. The form below is structured the way a shop reads a job.

01

Scope & drawings

Send the element, material, sector, and site. Drawings and finish references sharpen the first conversation.

02

Shop review

The studio reviews feasibility, material, and detailing against the drawings during studio hours.

03

Fabrication

Approved scope is fabricated in metal, glass, wood, or plaster to the agreed specification.

04

Delivery & install coordination

Finished elements are coordinated with your project team for delivery and installation sequencing.
